rehosted_source.local_tool_adaptation: Rename the pre-POSIX getline helper to avoid libc symbol collision.

toolchain: University of Toronto rnotroff (1985) and GNU groff
semantic_scope: The historical compatible converter parsed the untouched DEC RUNOFF document and translated it to troff. The rendered page contains the greeting.
path_normalization: Temporary paths use stable placeholders. Source hashes refer to the repository files listed in artifact_sha256.
